question_text: Outline why representing an image using a larger pixel grid can retain more spatial detail, assuming an unchanged field of view and adequate source image quality.
adaptation_rationale: Moves from display marketing to image representation in binary, without asserting resolution guarantees colour quality.
solution: The image is sampled at more positions; smaller features can be represented by separate pixels rather than merging into one.

marking_points.criterion: Finer features can be separately encoded.
